done_when: When close reports Ready and one or more other items are also Ready, its Next line names one 'forge land <this> <others>' command (forge merge stays for a single Ready item), and the skill has a short 'Keep CI fast' section: land Ready items together, do not rerun close while checks are queued, do not merge main by hand right before a merge; new and existing repos get it on upgrade and forge sync
why: Agents merge Ready items one at a time, so each merge after main moves costs a full CI run: forge close's Ready line says 'Next: forge merge <item>' even when other items are Ready, and the skill mentions the land train only in one table row; seen at a client on 19-20 Nov 2026
